verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows a pricing page exists, but the only quoted line from it is about automating workflows with schedules or webhooks. Nothing documents per-tool-call or per-connection pricing, and nothing documents rate limits. A community report says a credit-card requirement for rebuilds was undocumented, which further suggests pricing terms are not transparent.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see transparent pricing per tool call or connection plus documented rate limits before committing to the platform
